description_zh: 遍历媒体工作流执行实例
name: ListMediaWorkflowExecutions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media workflow for which you want to query execution instances. You can obtain the ID from the MPS console > Workflow Management > Workflow Settings
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询实例的媒体工作流ID。可以通过MPS控制台 > 工作流管理 > 工作流设置获取
parameters.name: media_workflow_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the media workflow. You can obtain the name from the MPS console > Workflow Management > Workflow Settings
parameters.help_zh: 媒体工作流名称。可以通过MPS控制台 > 工作流管理 > 工作流设置获取
parameters.name: media_workflow_name

parameters.help_en: The OSS bucket of the input file specified for the media workflow. The URL must follow RFC 3986 (UTF-8 encoded and URL-encoded for reserved characters). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.help_zh: 媒体工作流指定的输入文件OSS Bucket。遵循RFC 3986（UTF8编码，并对保留字符进行URLEncode）。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.name: input_file_url

parameters.help_en: The token used to return the next page. The token is a 32-bit UUID. When you request the first page, leave NextPageToken empty. When you request subsequent pages, pass the NextPageToken value returned from the previous page
parameters.help_zh: 下一页标识，32位UUID。请求第一页时，NextPageToken为空；请求后续文件时需传入前一页查询结果中的NextPageToken值
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of media workflow execution instances to return. Valid values: `[1,100]`. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 最大可返回的媒体工作流执行实例数。取值范围：`[1,100]`，默认值：10
parameters.name: maximum_page_size

Activity.description_en: The list of media workflow activities

Code.description_en:
The error code.

If the activity state is Fail, a specific error code is returned.

If the activity state is Success, this parameter is not returned
Code.description_zh:
错误码。

如果活动状态是Fail，会给出具体的错误码。

如果活动状态是Success，此参数不返回

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the activity. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
EndTime.description_zh: 活动结束执行时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

JobId.description_en: The ID of the job generated when the activity is executed. Save this ID for subsequent API calls
JobId.description_zh: 活动执行时生成的作业ID。建议您保存此ID便于后续调用其他接口时使用

MNSMessageResult.description_en: The job completion notification sent by Message Service (MNS)
MNSMessageResult.description_zh: MNS通知用户作业完成结果

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code when the execution fails. This parameter is not returned if the execution succeeds
ErrorCode.description_zh: 执行失败时错误码。如果执行成功则不返回此参数
ErrorCode.example: The Topic/Queue config is empty, not send message

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message when the execution fails. This parameter is not returned if the execution succeeds
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 执行失败时错误信息。如果执行成功则不返回此参数

MessageId.description_en: The ID of the message when the execution succeeds. This parameter is not returned if the execution fails
MessageId.description_zh: 执行成功时消息ID。如果执行失败则不返回此参数

Message.description_en:
The error message.

If the activity state is Fail, a detailed error message is returned.

If the activity state is Success, this parameter is not returned
Message.description_zh:
错误信息。

如果活动状态是Fail，会给出详细的错误描述信息。
如果活动状态是Success，此参数不返回

Name.description_en:
The name of the media workflow activity.

The activity name is unique within the same workflow
Name.description_zh:
媒体工作流活动名称。

在同一个工作流中活动的名称是唯一的

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the activity. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
StartTime.description_zh: 活动开始执行时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

State.description_en:
The state of the activity. Valid values:

Running: The activity is running.

Fail: The activity failed.

Skipped: The activity was skipped.

Success: The activity succeeded.

For example, if an analysis activity is followed by two transcoding activities for high definition and standard definition, the system makes a decision based on the actual analysis results. If the definition of the original video is insufficient, the high-definition transcoding activity may be skipped
State.description_zh:
活动状态。可取值：

Running：活动执行中。

Fail：活动执行失败。

Skipped：活动被跳过。
Success：执行成功。

例如：分析活动之后有高清、标清两个转码活动，会根据实际分析的结果来决策，如果原视频内容清晰度不够，高清的转码活动就可能被跳过

Type.description_en: The type of the media workflow activity. Valid values: Start, Snapshot, Transcode, Analysis, and Report. For more information, see [Media workflow activities]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2542772.html）
Type.description_zh: 媒体工作流活动类型。可取值：Start活动、Snapshot活动、Transcode活动、Analysis活动、Report活动。更多信息请参见[媒体工作流活动介绍]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2542772.html）

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

Input.description_en: The input of the media workflow
Input.description_zh: 媒体工作流的用户自定义数据

InputFile.description_en: The input OSS bucket of the media workflow
InputFile.description_zh: 媒体工作流的输入OSS Bucket

Bucket.description_en: The OSS bucket of the input file

Location.description_en: The OSS location of the input file

Object.description_en: The OSS object of the input file

MediaId.description_en: The media ID. All information generated by the media workflow belongs to this media ID
MediaId.description_zh: 媒体ID。媒体工作流生成的所有信息都属于这个媒体ID

MediaWorkflowId.description_en: The ID of the media workflow

Name.description_en: The name of the media workflow

RunId.description_en: The instance ID of the execute

State.description_en:
The state of the workflow. Valid values:

Running: The workflow is running.

Completed: The workflow execution is completed.

Completed only indicates that the workflow execution is completed. To check whether each activity (such as transcoding or snapshot) is successful, check the specific state of each activity.

Fail: The workflow execution failed.

Success: The workflow execution succeeded
State.description_zh:
工作流状态。可取值：

Running：执行中。

Completed：执行完成。

Completed仅表示工作流执行完成，每个活动（转码、截图等）是否成功要看每个活动具体的状态值。

Fail：执行失败。

Success：执行成功

NextPageToken.description_en: The token used to return the next page
